definitions.gloss: vocabulary book; word card booklet; flashcard set
definitions.explanation: A small booklet or set of cards used for memorizing vocabulary, typically with the word on one side and its meaning or translation on the other. A staple study tool for Japanese students.

examples.japanese: {単語帳|たんごちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}って→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}している→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧。

notes:
A compound of ⟦{単語|たんご}→単語：03413_tango⟧ (vocabulary word) and ⟦{帳|ちょう}→帳：10012_chou⟧ (notebook; booklet). The traditional {単語帳|たんごちょう} is a small ring-bound set of blank cards available at any stationery store in Japan. Students write the word on one side and the definition on the other, then flip through them to memorize. This is an iconic study tool in Japanese education.

Modern equivalents include vocabulary apps like Anki and Quizlet, which are sometimes also called {単語帳|たんごちょう}.

- {単語帳|たんごちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to make vocabulary flashcards
- {単語帳|たんごちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧めくる: to flip through flashcards
- {単語帳|たんごちょう}⟦アプリ→アプリ：04722_apuri⟧: vocabulary flashcard app
- ⟦{英語|えいご}→英語：02274_eigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{単語帳|たんごちょう}: English vocabulary book
